The boundary between the skin, the hood, and the gown collar is blurred and indistinct, suggesting the objects are fusing together rather than sitting on top of one another.
The fabric lacks realistic weave texture and appears overly smooth and plasticky, with unnatural specular highlights that do not match heavy wool or polyester.

The severe anatomical distortions further degrade the perceived validity of the subject wearing the garment.

Texture anomalies make the fabric look artificial. These are not minor glitches but fundamental generation errors that compromise the image's realism.
